Nearer,
still nearer,
while life shall last Till safe in glory my anchor is cast Through endless ages ever to be Nearer,
my Savior,
still nearer to Thee Nearer,
my Savior,
still nearer to Thee.

twi.title: WONKYƐN NKO ARA
verses:
Wonkyɛn nko ara, na ma me mɛn Twe me
m’Agyenkwa a wosom bo pii O yɛ me atuu,
me nna wo bom Na fa mesie wɛ saa
homebia hɔ Na fa mesie wɛ saa homebia hɔ.

Wonkyɛn nko ara menkura hwee Menni hwee de brɛ wo
Yesu me hene Sɛ me bɔne koma a abubu Ma
me ahote a, wo mogya no de ma Ma me
ahote a, wo mogya no de ma.

Wonkyɛn nko ara me nyɛ wo de Me po
bɔne nsɛm hunu anigyem Ɛmu anigye ne ahomasoɔ Fa
me wura Yesu a wosɛn no ma me Fa
me wura Yesu a wosɛn no ma me.

Wonkyɛn nko ara merɛ a mete ase yi Kosii
sɛ mɛdu anuonyam mu dwoodwoo Mpo sɛ daa apem
mu na mɛtena Wo nkyɛn m’agyenkwa wo nkyɛn nko
ara Wo nkyɛn m’Agyenkwa wo nkyɛn nko ara.

english.title: WHAT DID HE DO?
verses: O listen to our wondrous story Once we dwelt among the lost Yet Jesus came from heaven glory Saving us at awful cost

No angel could our place have taken Highest of the high tho He Nailed to the cross,
despised,
forsaken Was one of the Godhead three

Will you surrender to this Savior? Now before Him humbly bow You too,
shall come to know His favor,
He will save and save you now.
english.chorus: Who saved us from eternal lose? What did He do? Where is he now? In heaven interceding

twi.title: ƐYƐƐ DƐƐN?
verses:
O montie yɛn anwanwa sɛm yi
Merɛ bi na yɛn nso y’ayera
Yesu firi ne soro anuonyam mu
bae Ɛbɛtɔɔ yɛn abɔden

Soro Abɔfo bi ntumi nyina yɛannan
mu Sɛ ɛso sɛ dɛn mpo
a Wɔsɛe no na ɔbiara poo
no Nyame baasa koro no bi

Wode wo ho bɛma Agyenkwa
yi? Koto wɔ n’anim seesei
Wo nso bɛba abɛhu n’adom
no Ɛbegye wo seisei ara.
twi.chorus:
Hwan na ɛgyee yɛn fii daa yera mu?
Hwan sɛ Nyame ba wɔ asɛndua so? Dɛn
na ɔyɛɛe, ɔwui maa wo Ɛwɔ he afei,
gyedi sɛ ɔwɔ soro hɔ redi Ma yɛn

english.title: STANDING ON THE PROMISES
verses:
Standing on the promises of Christ my King Thru eternal ages let his praises ring Glory n the highest,
I will shout and sing Standing on the promises of God
Standing on the promises that cannot fall When the howling storms of doubt and fear as sail By the living Wordd of God I shall prevail

Standing on the promises I now can see Perfect,
present cleansing in the blood for me Standing in the liberty where Christ makes free
Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword

Standing on the promises I cannot fall,
Listning ev'ry moment to the Spirit's call Resting in my Savior,
as my all in all
english.chorus:
Standing,
standing,
standing on the promises of God My savior,
standing I'm standing on the promises of God

twi.title: MEGYINA BƐHYƐ NO SO
verses:
Megyina Kristo me hene bɛhyɛ noso
Monyi no ayɛ meresanten nyinaa mu
Anuonyam wɔ soro hɔ mɛteɛm ato
Megyina Nyame bɛhyɛ no so

Megyina bɛhyɛ a ɛntumi ngu no so
Sɛ akyingye ne suro mframa bɛ me
a Metintim Nyame nsɛm a ɛte ase
no mu Megyina Nyame bɛhyɛ no so

Megyina bɛhyɛ a afei mehu
no so Edware me te
me ho mogya no mu
Megyina Nyame bɛhyɛ no so
twi.chorus:
Megyina megyina Megyina m'Agyenkwa
Nyame bɛhyɛ no so
Megyina megyina Megyina Nyame
bɛhyɛ no so

english.title: WHO WILL FOLLOW JESUS?
verses:
Who will follow Jesus,
Standing for the right Holding up His banner In the thickest flight? List'ning for His orders,
ready to obey Who will follow Jesus,
Serving Him today?

Who will follow Jesus,
In life's busy ways Working for the Master,
giving Him the praise Earnest in His vineyard,
honoring his laws Faithful to his counsel,
watchful for his cause?

Who will follow Jesus,
when the temperature charms Fleeing,
then for safety to the savior's arms Trusting in His mercy,
trusting in His pow'r Seeding fresh renewals of his grace each hour?

Who will follow Jesus In His work of love,
Leading others to Him Lifting prayers above? Courage,
faithful servant In his word we see,
on our side for ever Will this savior be?
english.chorus:
Who will follow Jesus? Who will make reply,
'I am on the Lord's side,
master here am i? Who will follow Jesus? Who will make reply,
'I am on the Lord's side.

verses:

na bεdi Yesu akyi asom no εnnε?

Abɛ mɛden n'afuom adi ne mara so Atie
n'afotuo ahwɛ ne ho yie.

a Adwan' akɛ asomdwoe agyenkwa no nsam
Atwere n'ahumɛbɛ atwere ne tumi Ahwehwɛ ayɛ
foforo n'adom mu merε nyinaa
twi.chorus:

Mewɔ Awurade afa me wura me wɔ ha Hwan
na bεdi Yesu akyi Hwan na ɛbua sɛ Mewɔ
Awurade afa me wura me wɔ ha.

english.title: DOWN IN THE VALLEY
verses:
Down in the valley with my Saviour I would go,
where the flowers are blooming and the sweet waters flow,
everywhere he leads me I would follow,
follow on,
walking in his footsteps till the crown be won.

Down in the valley with my Saviour I would go,
where the storms are sweeping and the dark waters flow,
with his hand to lead me I will never,
never fear;
danger cannot fright me if my Lord is near.

Down in the valley or upon the mountain steep,
close beside my Saviour would my soul ever keep.
He will lead me safely in the path that he has trod,
up to where they gather on the hills of God.
english.chorus:
Follow,
follow,
I would follow Jesus,
anywhere,
everywhere,
I would follow on.
Follow,
follow,
I would follow Jesus.
Everywhere he leads me I would follow on.

Dεε nhwiren abu na nsuo dεεdε sene.

asɔrɔkyε rebb na εsum aduru no Sε ne

english.title: LEANING ON THE EVERLASTING ARMS
verses:
What a fellowship what a joy divine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms What a blessedness,
what a peace is mine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

O how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting arms O how bright the path grows from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting arms

What have I to dread,
what have I to fear,
Leaning on the everlasting arms I have blessed peace with my Lord so near Leaning on the everlasting arms.
english.chorus:
Leaning,
leaning Safe and secure from all alarms Leaning on the everlasting arms.

twi.title: METWERE BASA A ƐNWU DA NO
verses:
Yɛnkofa bɛn ni, anigye kronkron Metwere
basa a ɛnwu da no Nhyira
bɛn ni asomdwoe bɛn ni Metwere
basa a ɛnwu da no.

Akwantu yi mu nanteɛ ayɛ dɛ Metwere
basa a ɛnwu da no. O hwɛ
sɛ me kwan no mu hyerɛn daa
Metwere basa a ɛnwu da no.

Deɛn na ɛhuna me, deɛn na mesuro?
Metwere basa a ɛnwu da no Me
wura bɛn me yi menya asomdwoe Metwere
basa a ɛnwu da no.
twi.chorus:
Metwere, metwere (Metwere Yesu, metwere
Yesu) Akomatuo nni me so
bio Metwere, metwere Metwere basa
a ɛnwu da no.

english.title: I’LL GO WHERE YOU WANT ME TO GO
verses:
It may not be on the mountain’s height,
Or over the stormy sea It may not be at the battle’s front My Lord will have need of me But if I am needed anywhere,
In paths that I do not know I’ll answer,
dear Lord,
with my hand in Thine I’ll go where you want me to go.

Perhaps today there are loving words Which Jesus would have me speak There may be now in the paths of sin Some wand’rer whom I should seek O Savior,
if thou wilt be my guide Tho’dark and rugged the way My voice shall echo thy message sweet I’ll say what you want me to say.

There’s surely somewhere a lowly place In earth’s harvest fields so wide Where I may labor thro’life’s short day For Jesus,
the Crucified So trusting my all to Thy tender care And knowing thou lovest me I’ll do thy will with a heart sincere I’ll be what you want me to be.
english.chorus:
I’ll go where you want me to go Over mountain,
or plain or sea

twi.title: MƐKƆ DƐƐ WO PƐ SƐ MEKƆ
verses:
Ɛbi a n’ɛnnɛ mepɛ atifi Anaa ɛpo asorɔkye mu ɛbi a n’ɛnyɛ
ɔko bi anim Na me wura hia me Nanso sɛ ɔhia me
baabiara Akwan a mennim nso mpo a Mede me nsa bɛto me
wura deɛ m’ Mɛkɔ deɛ wo pɛ sɛ mekɔ.

Ɛbia nsɛmde bi wɔ hɔ ɛnnɛ A Yesu pɛsɛ meka ɛbia seisei
wɔ bɔne kwan mu Kobɔfoɔ bi hia me mmoa O Agyenkwa sɛ
wo kyerɛ me kwan Kwan no mu yɛ sum sɛn ara Me
nne bɛgyegye wo nsɛmde ho Mɛka deɛ wopɛ sɛ meka.

Ɛnyɛ den ara baabi wɔ Asaase tɛtrɛɛ yi so a Mɛyɛ adwuma
me nna tia yi mu Ama Yesu a ɔsɛn no no Ɛnti
mede m’ade nyinaa hyɛ wo nsa Na menim sɛ wo dɔ me
Mede anibere bɛyɛ wo pɛ Mɛyɛ deɛ wopɛ sɛ meyɛ.
twi.chorus:
Mɛkɔ deɛ wopɛ sɛ mekɔ me wura
Bepɔ so, pɛtɛɛm, ɛpo so anaa Mɛka
deɛ wopɛ sɛ meka, me wura Mɛyɛ
deɛ wopɛ sɛ meyɛ.

english.title: THE BREAKING OF BREAD
verses:
Dear Lord,
we break the bread,
In memory,
of that great sacrifice on Calvary This we do each Lord’s day,
As Christ hast said,
bless all disciples now who break the bread.

Bless thou the cup dear Lord,
To us this day,
may we with hearts prepared His word obey,
we now his death proclaim In his own way,
until he comes again,
We keep this day.

Our Savior now doth reign In heaven above,
death’s pow’r He overcame Such matchless love;
to heav’n he did ascend There He’s enthroned,
he is our dearest friend For us atoned.

twi.title: PAANOO NO BUBUO
verses:
Wura pa yɛbubu paanoo no de kae
Saa afɔre kɛseɛ no wɔ Calvary Yɛyɛ
sei Awurade da Kristo n’ahyɛ Hyira asuafoɔ
a wɔbu paanoo no seisei.

Hyira kuruwa yi so ma yɛn nnɛ‘wura pa.
Ma yɛn mfa koma pa ntie n’sɛm no
Yɛpae ne wuo mu ka sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ Yɛdi
saa daa yi kosi sɛ ɔbɛba

Yɛ‘Agyenkwa no di hene wɔ soro W’adi
wuo so nkunim ɔde bɛn ni? ɔforo
kɔ soro akɔdi hene ɔyɛ yɛn adamfo
pa, ɔtuaa yɛn ka no.

english.title: THE LILY OF THE VALLEY
verses:
I have found a friend in Jesus,
he’s everything to me He’s the fairest of ten thousand to my soul The lily of the valley,
in Him alone I see All I need to cleanse and make me fully whole In sorrow he’s my comfort,
in trouble he’s my stay He tells me every care on Him to roll He’s the bright and morning star,
he’s the fairest of Ten thousand to my soul

O He all my griefs has taken and all my sorrows home,
In temptation he’ s my strong and mighty tow’r I have all for him forsaken and all my idols torn From my heart,
and now he keeps me by His pow’r Tho all the world forsake me,
and Satan tempt me sore Thru Jesus I shall safely reach the goal,
He’s the bright and morning star,
he’s the fairest of Ten thousand to my soul.

He will never,
never leave me,

I’ve nothing now to fear,
With His manna He my hungry soul shall fill.
Then sweeping up to glory to see His blessed face Where rivers of delight shall ever roll,
He’s the bright and morning star,
he’s the fairest of Ten thousand to my soul.

verses:

The ark of age and the shrine of youth From her alone goes the word of truth.
Beyond are those who have conquered death Below are they who abide in faith The twain you host and the saints of earth One household are by a holy birth.

What glory there,
o what blessings here One hope,
on Lord and His name to wear One church,
one creed,

A mighty fortress is our God.
A bulwark never failing Our helper He,
amid the flood Of mortal ills prevailing,
For still our ancient foe Doth seek to work us woe His craft and pow’r are great And armed with cruel hate,
On earth is not his equal

Did we in our own strength confide Our striving would be losing Were not the right one on our side The man of God’s own choosing Dost ask who that may be? Christ Jesus,
it is he Lord Sabaoth His name From age to age the same And he must win the battle.

And tho’ this world with evil filled Should threaten to undo us We will not fear,
for God hath Willed his truth to triumph through us Let goods and kindred go,
This mortal life also The body they may kill God’s truth abideth still ,
His kingdom is forever.

Tho’the foe may rage and gather as the flood Let the standard be displayed And beneath its folds,
as soldiers of the Lord For the truth be not dismayed

Over land and sea,

Of the crimson banner now the story tell While the Lord shall claim His own

When the Great Commander,

Sounds the resurrection day,

love me more

In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease Still He calls,
in cares and pleasures,
Christian,
love me more than these
